item.title: Longyan Guanzhai Migu Baixiang Resort from ¥499 (≈$69): Hakka Mountain Rooms, Two Meals & 400 Mu of Forest at the 5A Guanzhaishan Gate
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥999) · Valid Nov 19, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Any day of the week · Book by 23:59 the day before · Refundable if unbooked

This is the hotel to pick if your kids would rather be outside than in a lobby. The resort sits at the foot of Guanzhaishan, a 5A national scenic area — the hotel’s back gate is effectively the mountain’s entrance, about a 4-minute drive to the main trails — and it owns 400 mu of private forest filled with more than 400 species of rare plants and animals, from red-bellied squirrels to kingfishers. The three low buildings are built in the local Hakka roundhouse style, with grey tiles and rammed-earth walls, and the lobby runs a 30-metre wooden front desk under a glass roof. In winter the forest here runs 3–6°C cooler than the city, and the air smells of pine and woodsmoke.

item.title: Ningde Baixiang Sanduao Hotel from ¥799 (≈$111): Lakeside Rooms, Two Meals & She Ethnic Dress-Up for the Kids
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥799 (≈$111, was ¥1,499) · Valid Sep 23 – Dec 31, 2026 · Any day of the week · Book by 23:59 on the day of use · Refundable if unbooked

Ningde is one of Fujian’s quieter coastal cities — a deep-water harbour town the poet Guo Moruo once described as a lake in the sky — and this is its big lakeside hotel. The Baixiang Sanduao sits on the East Lake waterfront in the Dongqiao district, backed by Damen Mountain, with 295 rooms spread along the lakefront promenade. The 12-metre lobby is hung with a relief of Huotong, the historic town nearby, and the whole building leans into a grand new-Chinese style: lake greens, coastal blues, and a lot of glass facing the water.

item.title: Shenzhen Luwan International Hotel from ¥399 (≈$55): French Chateau Rooms by the Sea, 3D Cinema & a Sea-View Splash Pool
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥1,288) · Valid Sep 24 – Dec 31, 2026 · Any day of the week, no weekend surcharge · Book by 17:00 on the day of use · Refundable if unbooked

Shenzhen’s east coast is the city’s answer to a seaside weekend — and this is the most theatrical place to stay on it. The Luwan International is a French-chateau resort set between the hills and the sea in the Meisha Bay resort area: three sides mountains, one side ocean, about 800 metres from the water. With Metro Line 8’s phase 3 now open, you can genuinely take the metro to the beach — the hotel is a 10-minute walk from Xiyong station’s Exit C — and the coastal boardwalk, the sea-view road and the beaches are all within a short drive.

item.title: Wen'an Hilton Curio Collection Hotel from ¥358 (≈$50): Lakeside Rooms, Afternoon Tea & New Year Fireworks by Huamei Shengdi
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥358 (≈$50, was ¥699) · Valid Nov 20, 2026 – Apr 29, 2027 · Any day of the week · Weekends, New Year & Spring Festival: no surcharge · Book by 23:00 the day before · Refundable if unbooked

If Beijing’s winter weekends feel too familiar, this is the escape 1.5 hours south: the Huamei Shengdi resort area in Wen’an, a spread of 10,000 mu of forest and 1,000 mu of lakes with a ski resort (opened November 14, 2026), a tractor park, go-karts and a New Year fireworks season. The hotel at its heart is a Hilton Curio Collection property built around wine culture — a European-castle exterior, a lobby that greets you with red-wine cocktails, and 266 rooms in a clean modern style, some with lake views.

item.title: Guangzhou Jinyezi Hot Spring Hotel from ¥399 (≈$55): Mountain Hot Springs, Water Park & Two Meals for 2 Adults + 2 Kids
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥988) · Valid Nov 18, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Any day of the week · Book by 17:00 on the day of use · Refundable if unbooked

They say summer is for water play and winter is for hot springs — but autumn is Jinyezi’s best season. Tucked into the forested hills beside the 4A Baishuizhai scenic area, about 26°C year-round and wrapped in 400,000 mu of forest at the foot of the Nankun Mountains, this Country Garden–run resort does the whole family day in one place: swim in the morning, soak in the evening.

item.title: Haining Chang'an Kaiyuan Mingdu Hotel from ¥399 (≈$55): Opening Deal — 2 Nights + Meals, No Weekend or Holiday Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night from ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥699) · Valid Nov 24, 2026 – May 30, 2027 · No surcharge on weekends, New Year, Spring Festival or May Day · Book by 19:00 the day before use · Refundable if unbooked

This is an opening deal for a brand-new hotel: the Chang’an Kaiyuan Mingdu holds its opening ceremony on November 25, 2026, and the packages are priced for the launch — the 2-night headline rate of ¥588 works out to ¥294 a night with a meal thrown in per night, and the long validity runs all the way through May Day 2027 with zero surcharge on weekends, New Year, Spring Festival or May Day.

item.title: Jiashan Yunlanwan Hot Spring Hotel — 1 Night + Hot Springs from ¥659 (≈$92)
item.description: Deal price: 1 night in a deluxe room + breakfast for 2 + 2 hot-spring tickets + flower-sea park + building-block park — ¥659 (≈$92, was ¥1,388) · Family hot-spring room (private spring) + breakfast for 3 ¥799 (≈$111, was ¥1,688) · 1 night + dinner set ¥899 (≈$125, was ¥1,388) · Family room + breakfast for 4 ¥999 (≈$139, was ¥1,688) · 2 nights ¥1,198 (≈$166, was ¥3,376) · 2 nights in a family room ¥1,699 (≈$236, was ¥3,376) · Valid Sep 19 – Dec 31, 2026

item.title: Nanjing Banyan Tree — 2 Nights in a Cliff Room with Private Hot Spring from ¥3,188 (≈$443)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights in a 60㎡ cliff room + breakfast for 2 + ¥100 dining voucher + hot springs + 2 scenic tickets — ¥3,188 (≈$443, was ¥3,999) · 3 nights in a cliff room + ¥200 voucher ¥3,999 (≈$555, was ¥4,999) · 2 nights in a 90㎡ cliff suite + ¥500 voucher ¥6,999 (≈$972, was ¥8,999) · Valid Oct 15, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027

Banyan Tree’s Nanjing resort is built into a disused quarry inside the Jiangsu Garden Expo Park at Tangshan — 115 rooms set into the cliff face above the old quarry valley, with a garden grown on the valley floor where the mine used to be. It is the most photographed resort hotel in Nanjing for a reason: the entrance sits at the top of the cliff, and the whole building reads as an extension of the rock.

item.title: Qiandao Lake Kaiyuan Resort — 1 Night + Car Town Tickets from ¥398 (≈$55)
item.description: Deal price: 1 night in a superior twin room + breakfast for 2 + afternoon tea for 2 — ¥398 (≈$55, was ¥899) · 1 night in a lake-view room + car town family ticket ¥598 (≈$83, was ¥899) · 2 nights in a superior twin room + car town family ticket ¥728 (≈$101, was ¥899) · 2 nights in a lake-view room + ¥388 fish-head dinner set + car town family ticket ¥1,188 (≈$165, was ¥1,899) · Valid Nov 25, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027

item.title: Taicang Club Med Ski Resort — 2 Nights + Ski Passes from ¥1,698 (≈$236)
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights + 3-hour beginner-slope ski passes (with snow play) — ¥1,698 (≈$236, was ¥3,434) · 2 nights + full-day beginner-slope ski passes + 2 × 3-hour snow play ¥1,898 (≈$264, was ¥3,772) · Valid Nov 20, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027, any day of the week

Club Med’s Taicang resort sits inside the Alps Snow World indoor-ski complex — the “Oriental Alps” — about an hour’s drive from Shanghai or Suzhou, and a short ride from Taicang South railway station. This is a proper ski-in, ski-out style stay without the mountain weather: the beginner slope and snow-play areas are indoors, so the snow is guaranteed all winter, and the resort’s G.O. team runs the activities, evening shows and dance parties while you are there.

item.title: Yiwu Senshan Junlan Resort — New Wellness Retreat from ¥499 (≈$69), No Top-Up on Weekends or Holidays
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a lake-view room + breakfast for 2 + hanfu experience + AI body scan — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥699) · 2 nights in a garden king room ¥599 (≈$83, was ¥999) · 2 nights in a lake-view room ¥699 (≈$97, was ¥1,299) · Valid Nov 12, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · No top-up on weekends, New Year or Spring Festival

Senshan Junlan is a brand-new Junlan wellness resort that began trial operation on November 10, 2026, inside the 6,000-acre Senshan health town in Yiwu — Song-dynasty styling, white walls and dark tiles, built around dendrobium (tiepi shihu) herbal culture, facing a lake and backed by forested hills. It is a short trip from Yiwu International Trade City, Fotang Ancient Town and Hengdian World Studios, with high-speed rail, light rail and expressway connections.

item.title: Zhangzhou Duoleng Hot Spring Hotel — 1 Night + Breakfast + Unlimited Hot Springs from ¥299 (≈$42)
item.description:
Deal price: deluxe room for 1 night + breakfast for 2 + unlimited hot-spring park for 2 for the whole stay — ¥299 (≈$42, was ¥999, about 30% of list) · Valid Nov 19, 2026 – Jun 30, 2027, any day of the week · No top-up on weekdays or weekends

Duoleng sits in Jiaomei, just across the water from Xiamen — close enough that metro Line 6 gets you there — and the deal is unusually simple for a hot-spring stay: one price covers the room, breakfast for two, and unlimited entry to the hot-spring park for the whole stay, with no weekend top-up at all. The park has outdoor pools, a swimming pool, a children’s area, stone-spring pools, a spa hall with bubble jets and high-pressure water massage, and a fish-therapy pool. Free parking and Wi-Fi are included, and the nearby Jiaomei Wanda mall gives you somewhere to wander in the evening.

item.title: Conghua Tianrenshanshui Valley Camp — Hot-Spring Pool Room from ¥699 (≈$97)
item.description:
Deal price: hot-spring pool room for 1 night + breakfast for 2 + fish-head-pot dinner for 2 + Earth Art Park entry + 3 two-day play wristbands — ¥699 (≈$97, was ¥1,299) · Valid Nov 18 – Dec 30, 2026 · Any day of the week

This is the pool-room tier of Tianrenshanshui Valley Camp — a different package from the tent/RV/cabin stay already on this site. Here you pick one of three rooms, each with its own hot-spring pool: a courtyard pool room, a duplex RV pool room, or a wooden cabin tent with one bedroom and one living room. Breakfast for two and a fish-head-pot dinner for two (with Xufu stewed rice) are included, and the deal is built around two days in the park rather than one night in a room.

item.title: Dehua Lusheng Ceramic Hotel — 1 Night from ¥499 (≈$69)
item.description: Deal price: city room for 1 night + breakfast for 3 + lunch for 2 + ceramic factory & museum tour — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥888) · 2 nights ¥829 (≈$115, was ¥1,388) · Tao Bai family room ¥759 (≈$105, was ¥1,299) · Family room, 2 nights ¥1,399 (≈$194, was ¥1,899) · Valid Nov 18, 2026 – Jan 30, 2027 · Book by Nov 25 for a free ceramic DIY session

item.title: Guangzhou Hehui Hot Spring Hotel — Pool Room for 2 Adults + 2 Kids from ¥699 (≈$97)
item.description: Deal price: advanced pool room for 1 night + breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids + unlimited hot springs + infinity pool — ¥699 (≈$97, was ¥1,288) · With dinner buffet for 2 + 2 ¥899 (≈$125, was ¥1,488) · Buy-1-get-1 (2 rooms or 2 nights) ¥1,299 (≈$180, was ¥2,188) · Family theme room with dinner ¥1,099 (≈$153, was ¥1,788) · Valid Nov 22, 2026 – Apr 29, 2027

item.title: Nanping Bestway Hotel + Wuyi Dream Huacheng Tickets — Garden-View Room from ¥439 (≈$61)
item.description:
Deal price: garden-view room for 1 night + breakfast for 2 + 2 Wuyi Dream Huacheng tickets — ¥439 (≈$61, was ¥976) · Advanced standard room, 2 nights (or 1 night × 2 rooms) — ¥599 (≈$83, was ¥976) · Valid Nov 13, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · Friday–Sunday only

Nanping Bestway Hotel sits in Jianyang, about 40 minutes’ drive from Wuyi Mountain National Park, and this deal pairs the stay with the thing that makes the trip: Wuyi Dream Huacheng, an immersive Song-dynasty show village where you walk through ancient streets in costume. The tickets include a hanfu rental (3,000 sets to choose from), NPC immersive interaction and the Song-style buildings themselves — so the evening is a show, not just a room.

item.title: Zhangzhou Southeast Flower City Hot Spring Hotel — 1 Night for 2 Adults + 1 Child from ¥298 (≈$41)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night for 2 adults + 1 child (under 1.4 m) + breakfast + hot-spring tickets + Flower Expo Park tickets — ¥298 (≈$41, was ¥518) · 2 nights ¥558 (≈$78, was ¥1,036) · Garden villa room ¥358 (≈$50, was ¥618) · Bamboo house with fishing ¥498 (≈$69, was ¥828) · Valid Nov 18, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · No weekend top-up

Southeast Flower City is a hillside hot-spring resort in Zhangpu, about an hour from Xiamen, built in terraces up the mountain with shuttle carts running everywhere. The deal is priced for the family unit — 2 adults + 1 child under 1.4 m — and every tier includes breakfast for the three of you, hot-spring tickets and tickets to the Flower Expo Park next door, which runs a light show in the evening. The headline ¥298 tier is the 25 m² Yingbin Building room; the garden villa (¥358) and the 60 m² bamboo house (¥498, with a fishing session and its own private spring) step up the room, and every tier has a 2-night version that works out cheaper per night.

item.title: Gubei Water Town Two-Hotel Pass from ¥999 (≈$139): 1 Night, 3 Town Tickets, 3 Hot-Spring Tickets & Breakfast for 3
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night for 3 from ¥999 (≈$139, was ¥1,758) · 2 nights ¥1,599 (≈$222, was ¥3,288) · Valid Nov 20, 2026 – Jul 15, 2027 · Book at least 2 days ahead · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Gubei Water Town is the canal town under the Simatai Great Wall, about two hours from central Beijing — and this pass is the flexible way to stay there: one voucher works at either of two hotels inside the town, the Gubei Zhiguang or the Hangu, so you pick whichever has rooms on your dates. The price is built for three adults, which makes it a natural fit for two parents and a grandparent, or two adults and an older child.

item.title: Gubei William Edgar Hotel from ¥899 (≈$125): 1 Night with Town Tickets, Hot-Spring Tickets & a Great Wall Day Trip
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast for 2 + town tickets ×2 + hot-spring tickets ×2 — ¥899 (≈$125, was ¥1,210) · Valid Nov 20, 2026 – Jul 15, 2027 · Book at least 2 days ahead · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

The William Edgar is one of the hotels inside Gubei Water Town, the canal town under the Simatai Great Wall — and this is its simplest deal: one night, breakfast for two, town tickets and hot-spring tickets for two, plus a pick-one extra. The standout choice in that extra is the Simatai Great Wall day ticket, which turns the stay into a wall-and-water-town weekend without a separate ticket purchase.

item.title: Xiamen Riyuegu Hot Spring + Beef Hotpot from ¥239 (≈$33): Soak, Eat, and Bring a Child Free
item.description:
Deal price: hot-spring ticket + beef hotpot for one from ¥239 (≈$33, was ¥348) · Two-person set ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥686) · VIP two-person set with the kids’ water park ¥388 (≈$54, was ¥568) · Valid Nov 19 – Dec 31, 2026 · Each adult can bring one child under 1.5 m free · Unused vouchers are refundable, and expired ones refund automatically

Riyuegu is Xiamen’s big Southeast-Asian-style hot-spring village out in Haicang, and this is its winter combo: a full day in the pools plus a beef hotpot meal, with the resort’s extras — a treasure hunt, a sound-bowl meditation, a game room and a very friendly Alaskan dog — thrown in. Every tier lets each paying adult bring one child under 1.5 m free, so a family of three can do the single-person set for ¥239 plus one free child, or the two-person set for two adults and two children.

item.title: Longjia Hotel Private Hot-Spring Room, Zhangzhou — from ¥428 (≈$59) a Night, was ¥668
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥428 (≈$59) a night (was ¥668) · Private hot-spring room + breakfast for two + 2 hot-spring passes · Valid Nov 4, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027 · Book at least a day ahead · Unused vouchers are refundable

Longjia Hotel （漳州龙佳大酒店） sits in its own eco hot-spring villa in Jiaomei — the town Xiamen locals call the city’s “back garden” — about 40 minutes out on Metro Line 6. The deal is a room with its own private soaking pool: you get the room, breakfast for two, and two passes to the hotel’s hot-spring pools, so you can soak in your room and then again in the shared springs. It’s an old, established hot-spring hotel rather than a new resort, and the reviews read like a regulars’ favourite.

item.title: Shankouling Village Resort near Hefei — from ¥369 (≈$51) a Night incl. Breakfast, Noodles & Afternoon Tea, was ¥1,388
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥369 (≈$51) a night (was ¥1,388) · Boutique room + breakfast + 2 handmade-noodle meals + afternoon tea for two + White Horse Mountain hike · Valid Nov 4 – Dec 31, 2026 · Book by 20:00 on the day · Unused vouchers are refundable

Shankouling （山口凌度假村） is a boutique stay in a century-old village about an hour from central Hefei — the village locals call a “little Jingdezhen” for its old kilns and craft shops. The deal is an all-in-one slow day out: a night in a light-luxury country room, breakfast, two bowls of handmade noodles at the village noodle shop, afternoon tea for two at the village bookshop, a hike up White Horse Mountain (walking sticks provided), camping on the village green, and the village art museum. No top-ups inside the validity period.

item.title: Beixi Tangjing Hot Spring Lodge, Zhangzhou — 1 Night + Campsite BBQ from ¥499 (≈$69), was ¥888
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids + outdoor hot-spring park + campsite BBQ for two — ¥499 (≈$69, was ¥888, about 44% off) · Private-spring room ¥599 (was ¥988) · Valid Sep 3 – Dec 30, 2026 · Weekends with no top-up · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Beixi Tangjing Hot Spring Lodge （北溪·汤境温泉宿集） is a soak-stay-and-eat combo in the hills outside Zhangzhou: a hot-spring park plus lodging in one, so the whole weekend happens without moving the car. The park has 17 outdoor pools and 3 indoor pools fed by metasilicic-acid spring water (≥25 mg/L), plus a forest outdoor pool that stays open through autumn and winter. Then, as evening comes, the campsite BBQ takes over — a two-person set (worth ¥178) with Angus beef cuts, wagyu, Austrian black pork and vegetables, grilled at your own pitch in the woods with background music drifting through the trees.

item.title: Riyuegu Hot Spring 4-Visit Card, Xiamen — ¥399 (≈$55) for 4 Visits, was ¥1,072
item.description:
Deal price: 4 hot-spring visits + 4 Kids’ Fun Palace entries — ¥399 (≈$55, was ¥1,072, about 63% off) · Valid Nov 10 – Dec 31, 2026 · Use all 4 at once or split them across visits · Unused vouchers are refundable

Riyuegu Hot Spring Resort （日月谷温泉渡假村） is Xiamen’s old favourite — a 20-plus-year-old resort village that regulars describe as a slice of Bali tucked into the hills of Haicang. This card covers 4 visits: each visit is one adult weekday hot-spring ticket plus one Kids’ Fun Palace ticket, and each visit can bring one child under 1.2 m free. Use all four in one family day out, or spread them across the season — the ticket and the Fun Palace entry can’t be split from each other, but the four visits are independent.

item.title: Tangcheng Yupin Hot Spring Hotel, Yongchun — 1 Night with Private Balcony Pool from ¥428 (≈$59), was ¥738
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a hot-spring room + breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids + unlimited hot-spring park — ¥428 (≈$59, was ¥738, about 42% off) · Valid Sep 23 – Dec 31, 2026 · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Tangcheng Yupin Hot Spring Hotel （永春汤城御品温泉酒店） is the “little Bali” an hour or so from Xiamen — a hot-spring resort in Yongchun, Quanzhou where the spring water is piped into the rooms themselves. Every room in this deal comes with its own balcony hot-spring pool, so you can soak in private while looking out over the hills, then head down to the hot-spring park with 20+ garden pools — flower-petal pools, a mahjong pool, private nooks — as many times as you like during your stay. There is also an infinity pool, a spa area that the hotel pitches as the cure for a stiff office back, and a kids’ water park that takes over in the afternoons.

item.title: Tong'an Jinsuiyuan Hot Spring, Xiamen — ¥58 (≈$8) a Person, was ¥196
item.description:
Deal price: ¥58 (≈$8) a person (was ¥196, about 70% off) · Double ticket ¥110 (was ¥392) · Valid Jan 1 – Dec 31, 2026, any day of the week · Buy and use the same day · Unused vouchers are refundable

Jinsuiyuan Hot Spring （同安金穗园温泉） is a 4A-standard hot-spring park in Tong’an, Xiamen — about 25 acres of gardens, pavilions and winding paths hiding 50+ wellness pools, a national-standard indoor hot-spring pool, a large spa area and a Jurassic-themed hot-spring water park for kids. The water is the draw here: a rare silicate spring drawn from 158 m underground, coming out at 65°C, famously silky on the skin — the old line about it is “spring water so smooth it washes away the dust.”

item.title: Fufeng Dijian Nanshan Hot Spring Hotel, Baoji — 5 Nights from ¥999 (≈$138), was ¥1,790, with 10 Hot-Spring Entries
item.description:
Deal price: 5 nights (splittable) + 10 breakfasts + 10 hot-spring entries + 2 camping spots — ¥999 (≈$138, was ¥1,790, about 44% off) · Valid Jul 20 – Dec 31, 2026 · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Fufeng Dijian Nanshan Hot Spring Hotel （扶风地建南山温泉酒店） is a slow-travel, soak-and-stay deal in Baoji, Shaanxi — about 1.1 km from the 5A-rated Famen Temple, home of the famous finger-bone relic of the Buddha. The package covers 5 nights at either of two sister hotels (the Fufeng Dijian Nanshan Hot Spring Hotel by the Famen cultural scenic area, or the Dijian Nanshan Qianhe Hotel), and the nights can be split however you like within the validity period: 1 room for 5 nights, 5 rooms for 1 night, or any combination in between.

item.title: Nanjing Yihe Jiezi Garden Hotel — 5 Nights from ¥2,240 (≈$309), was ¥3,200, Inside Laomendong
item.description:
Deal price: 5 nights in a 30–41㎡ Yayun room — ¥2,240 (≈$309, was ¥3,200, 30% off) · Valid Aug 31 – Dec 30, 2026 · Fri–Sat no top-up · Book by 17:00 the day before · Nights can be split · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Nanjing Yihe Jiezi Garden Hotel （南京颐和芥子园酒店） is a garden hotel with a real history: it stands on the site of the Jiezi Garden built 300 years ago by Li Yu, the Ming–Qing scholar who wrote The Mustard Seed Garden Manual of Painting — the classic Chinese painting textbook. The Yihe group restored the garden as a museum-style hotel, so you sleep inside a Ming–Qing garden of pavilions, rockeries and winding stone paths, right in the Laomendong scenic area — and the garden itself is open to the public by day but reserved for guests in the early morning and evening.

item.title: Qingdao Silver Beach Wyndham Supreme Hotel — 1 Night from ¥549 (≈$76), was ¥1,298, with Dinner Buffet & No Holiday Top-Up
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a 40㎡ sea-view room + breakfast for two + dinner buffet or Chinese set for two — ¥549 (≈$76, was ¥1,298, about 58% off) · Valid Oct 20, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027 · New Year’s Eve, New Year & Spring Festival — no top-up · Book by 18:00 on the day · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Qingdao Silver Beach Wyndham Supreme Hotel （青岛银沙滩温德姆至尊酒店） is a seaside stay where the beach is genuinely part of the hotel: a VIP walkway gets you to Silver Beach in 2 minutes, Golden Beach is a 5-minute drive, and Tangdaowan Park is across the street. Every room has a private balcony — the 40㎡ sea-view rooms look out over the bay — and the hotel was designed with ocean touches throughout, from the high-ceilinged lobby to the in-house Bavarian-style beer house.

item.title: Shanghai Yaoxue Crowne Plaza — 1 Night from ¥999 (≈$138), was ¥2,098, with Snow-Play Tickets & Lunch Buffet
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + breakfast for two + snow-play tickets for 2 adults + 1 child + lunch buffet for 2 adults + 1 child — ¥999 (≈$138, was ¥2,098, about 52% off) · Snow-play tier valid Nov 7, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · Book by 23:59 the day before · Unbooked vouchers are refundable

Shanghai Yaoxue Crowne Plaza （上海冰雪世界皇冠假日酒店） is the official hotel of Yaoxue Ice & Snow World — walk through Xingyao Plaza and you are at the snow park. The park is a 98,000㎡ indoor snow world kept at −3°C to −5°C all year, with a real-snow ski slope and a Nordic-themed snow-play zone of 10+ activities: the Snow Country Train, ice-cave exploring, snow climbing, speed sledding, ice bikes, snow-house building and more. The hotel itself leans into the theme — 370 rooms with ski and snow-mountain details (even the tissue box is shaped like a snow cabin), a spiral staircase that has become a photo spot, and a 24-hour gym.
